arguments.sql: WITH cnts AS (SELECT student_course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT transcript_id) AS cnt FROM Transcript_Contents GROUP BY student_course_id) SELECT student_course_id, cnt FROM cnts WHERE cnt = (SELECT MAX(cnt) FROM cnts)

content: SELECT student_course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT transcript_id) AS max_count FROM Transcript_Contents GROUP BY student_course_id ORDER BY max_count DESC LIMIT 1
